text: A song of ascents. I When the Lord restored the captives of Zion, [AA]we thought we were dreaming.
Then our mouths were filled with laughter;our tongues sang for joy. [AB]Then it was said among the nations,"The Lord had done great things for them."
The Lord has done great things for us;Oh, how happy we were!
Restore our captives, Lord,like the dry stream beds of the Negeb. [1]
II Those who sow in tearswill reap with cries of joy. [AC]
Those who go forth weeping,carrying sacks of seed,Will return with cries of joy,carrying their bundled sheaves.
